name: conclude-it
description: DevOtts marketplace for Claude Code plugins. Add this repo, then install conclude-it (the session-close + ship ritual) — shares the `devotts` namespace with plan-it, build-it, review-it, and prompt-it.

plugins.name: conclude-it
plugins.description: The single front door for every session close — the ship stage of the *-it lifecycle. Step-0 triage detects ship-shaped sessions and runs the ship pipeline first (local test gate → merge+deploy → prod gate → archive → backlog → PM), then the session-close core every session gets: debrief with supersession sweep, ledger card, mid-flight verification, subagent reaping, footprint sweep incl. secrets at rest, local CONCLUDE_REPORT.html, honest safe-to-exit verdict.
